items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Quenton Nelson (knee) was listed as a limited participant on Wednesday.
items.impact: Nelson is still dealing with a nagging knee issue, but it is unlikely to affect his availability for Week 9. He should play and continue to be a difference maker for Seattle's offensive front moving forward.
items.title: Quenton Nelson (knee) listed as limited Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc:
Rashid Shaheed (knee) missed Seattle's
practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout missed Seattle's last game due to a knee issue, and it prevented him from practicing on Wednesday as well. His participation at practice on Thursday and Friday will be much more telling for his outlook for Week 9, however.
items.title: Rashid Shaheed (knee) misses practice Wednesday
